class.name: IfcCurveStyleFontPattern
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : A curve style font pattern is a pair of visible and invisible curve segment length measures in presentation area units. NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 name: curve_style_font_pattern. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-46:1994 for the final definition of the formal standard. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x2.

members.member: The length of the visible segment in the pattern definition. NOTE For a visible segment representing a point, the value 0. should be assigned. IFC2x Edition 3 CHANGE The datatype has been changed to IfcLengthMeasure with upward compatibility for file-based exchange. A float, or null when unset.
The length of the invisible segment in the pattern definition. A float, or null when unset.
